description: Find community tools and open-source projects discussed on Entra.Chat episodes. Returns tool names, the episodes where they were discussed, and timestamped YouTube links to hear the discussion. Optionally filter by keyword.

limit.description: Maximum number of tool mentions to return (default: 20)

query.description: Optional filter — search by tool name or keyword (e.g. "Maester", "PowerShell", "Conditional Access")

name: find_tool_mentions
